svg.text: MAGNET LAYOUT — WHERE THE MAGNETS GO
the four fitted magnets; best four positions on the plate
mid-side HOLES are cut, magnets not fitted — the upgrade path
corners plus a second row up the sides; NOT cut
A magnet ON a centreline has ZERO lever about that centreline. That is why mid-side and diagonal
positions keep losing, and why the corners win: they work about BOTH axes at once.
Peel resistance is identical in all three: symmetric layouts depend only on HOW MANY magnets, never where.
